title: 【ダンス基礎】基本ステップ練習まとめ15種類
teacher: LIttle Starダンスレッスンチャンネル

method.teacher_system: The teacher demonstrates a series of 15 basic dance steps sequentially in front of a mirror. Each step is introduced with on-screen step names and brief instructional bullet points, performed continuously to music.

practices.what: Demonstrates the box step to the right with on-screen bullet points explaining foot movement and arm freedom.
Demonstrates the box step to the left.
Demonstrates the kick step with on-screen notes about kicking forward and jumping.
Demonstrates the Biz Markie step with a note on light jumps when extending arms.
Demonstrates the paddle box step, showing sideways and backwards foot positioning and body angle changes.
Demonstrates the Charleston step with foot in-out movements and lifting one leg on even counts.
Demonstrates the running man step with back foot lifts and front drops.
Demonstrates the Brooklyn step, pulling elbows back and angling the body.
Demonstrates the shuffle step involving kicking, landing, and stepping back.
Demonstrates the SpongeBob step, kicking while jumping outward on the standing leg.
Demonstrates the club open step by moving toes and heels.
Demonstrates the club close step using toe and heel movements.

moments.says: The teacher introduces a comprehensive video covering fifteen different basic dance steps for beginners.
The teacher demonstrates the right box step with clear visual breakdowns of footwork and arm placement.
The teacher concludes the session and encourages viewers to subscribe for future lessons.

mentor.what_stays: The teacher leaves the learner feeling equipped and ready to practice fundamental dance steps with clear visual guidance.

struggles.theme: Steps are too fast or difficult for complete beginners
Cannot make movements look as cool as the teacher
Gets out of breath or physically exhausted quickly

clicked.theme: Clear, easy to follow, and helpful explanations
Great for practicing school dance routines or P.E. classes
Fun and provides a good workout or cardio

meant.theme: Grateful for a beginner-friendly resource to practice daily

method.limits: There is no spoken audio instruction or direct verbal commentary from the teacher; only on-screen text and background music are present.
